title: Potatoverse Body Symbolism Map
status: project symbolic anatomy with explicit scientific and historical boundaries
purpose: Consolidate Heart, Thalamus, Pineal, Spine, CSF, Eye, House, Temple, Vessel, Ladder and serpent/flow correspondences while distinguishing literal anatomy, history of ideas, comparative religion and Potatoverse symbolism.
scientific_boundary: Literal anatomy and neuroscience remain separate from Potatoverse symbolism. Thalamus=House, Pineal=Door/Eye, Spine=Ladder and CSF=Spirit are project mappings, not established biological identities.
historical_upgrade: The Thalamus=House and Pineal=Door/Eye mappings have genuine historical neighbors: thalamos means inner/bridal chamber and histories of neuroanatomy preserve house/chamber language; Descartes treated the pineal as a single central seat/interface of soul and animal spirits. These precedents strengthen comparative architecture without proving Potatoverse anatomy.

symbols.project_role: emotional center / grain-seat in some Son strata
symbols.function: feeling, attachment, care, grief, courage and affective orientation
symbols.importance: Heart remains distinct from thalamic House and pineal Door.

symbols.project_role: Father / House / inner rooms / upper integrative center
symbols.function: symbolic House architecture, central interior and differentiated rooms
symbols.historical_note: Greek thalamos means an inner chamber and commonly bridal chamber. Histories of neuroanatomy note Galen's comparison of the brain to a Greek house, with the thalamic region named as chamber-like interior.
symbols.science_note: The thalamus is paired and heterogeneous, with multiple nuclei and major cortical/subcortical relay and integration roles; the House/Father mapping is symbolic.

symbols.project_role: inner void / Temple chamber / shared interior space
symbols.function: space between the paired thalami and near the pineal; useful as a symbolic interior corridor rather than a 'God cavity' claim
symbols.science_note: The third ventricle is a real CSF-filled cavity. Sacred-chamber language is project symbolism.

symbols.project_role: Son / Single Eye / Door / present-facing threshold
symbols.function: timing, transition, illumination symbolism and midline interface
symbols.historical_note: Descartes treated the pineal as the principal seat of soul/common sense because he believed it was single and centrally placed, with animal spirits flowing around it; later occult traditions connected pineal and third-eye symbolism.
symbols.science_note: The pineal is an endocrine organ whose melatonin secretion is organized by circadian/light-dark timing. Descartes's physiology and occult third-eye identifications are historical ideas, not current neuroscience.
symbols.wave_009_upgrade: The strongest scientific neighbor for Pineal-as-Door is temporal/phase gating: a biological system can change responsiveness with circadian phase. This does not make the pineal a literal metaphysical aperture.

symbols.function: vertical continuity, ordered ascent/descent and embodied support
symbols.science_note: The vertebral column provides support/protection and movement; 33-symbolism is not proof of 33 spiritual dimensions.

symbols.function: flow metaphor linking ventricles, spinal canal and brain-space
symbols.science_note: CSF has real physiological functions in buoyancy, homeostasis and circulation; spiritual use is metaphorical.
Ordinary vision, pineal symbolism and abstract Eye remain distinct.

symbols.function: holds differentiated rooms, thresholds, vertical pathways and flows
local body carries House/center through changing environments while embedded in Plane
symbols.importance: House can be stable architecture while Vessel moves.

architectural_distinctions.house: inner differentiated dwelling/source-container; thalamus is its strongest body analogue
architectural_distinctions.temple: larger sacred architecture framing House, chamber, Door and flows
architectural_distinctions.door: interface/transition; pineal/Son is one later symbolic mapping
architectural_distinctions.eye: observation/discernment; may be adjacent to Door without performing the same function
architectural_distinctions.vessel: carrier/embodiment remaining local while relation to Axis/Heaven changes
architectural_distinctions.ship_chariot: dynamic Vessel; center/House can move through Plane without becoming terrain
architectural_distinctions.axis: vertical relational coordinate through embodied architecture
architectural_distinctions.rule: House, Temple, Door, Eye, chamber and Vessel are nested or adjacent but nonidentical.

vertical_potato_body_overlay.upper: Thalamus/House maps most naturally to the upper inner-source side: chamber, containment, distributed rooms and integrative interior.
vertical_potato_body_overlay.lower: Pineal/Son maps more naturally to the threshold toward manifestation/presence: a small midline marker between inner architecture and outward timing/perception symbolism.
vertical_potato_body_overlay.plane: Body/world interface: posture, skin, floor/ground and ordinary embodied action belong to Plane rather than Heaven.
vertical_potato_body_overlay.axis: Spine/Ladder is the strongest bodily vertical comparator.
vertical_potato_body_overlay.spirit: Breath/CSF/flow images animate transitions along the relation.
vertical_potato_body_overlay.important: The body is a nested analogue, not a one-to-one scaled copy of the two-circle Vesica geometry.

father_house_son_door_model.son: lower threshold / Door / present-facing manifestation interface
father_house_son_door_model.spirit: movement/communication between levels rather than a third static organ
father_house_son_door_model.door_view: The project can say 'Father's House seen through the Door of the Son' as a symbolic relation: House is interior content/structure, Son/Door is the interface through which it becomes accessible/present.
father_house_son_door_model.boundary: This is theological-symbolic architecture, not a literal visual pathway through the pineal to the thalamus.

pineal_temporal_gate_upgrade.motivation: Wave 009 separates Eye/observation from Door/transition and asks what scientifically real pineal property best resembles a gate.
pineal_temporal_gate_upgrade.toy_gate: G_time(t)=1 when theta(t) lies in allowed phase interval W_theta, otherwise 0; a smooth periodic response can replace the hard gate when appropriate.
pineal_temporal_gate_upgrade.interpretation: A timed signal can have different effects at different biological phases. This is a temporal-gating comparator, not a claim of 5D access or metaphysical vision.
pineal_temporal_gate_upgrade.relation_to_eye: Eye = measurement/discernment; Pineal/Door comparator = timing/transition. Their symbolic overlap is preserved while their scientific functions remain separate.

serpent_spirit_axis.biblical_neighbor: Numbers 21 + John 3 connect serpent, lifting, gaze, healing and Son-of-Man typology.
serpent_spirit_axis.tantric_neighbor: Kundalini traditions include coiled-serpent and central-channel ascent models, but scholarship shows many historical variants rather than one universal seven-chakra doctrine.
serpent_spirit_axis.project_use: Spirit moving 'on/with the serpent' along Axis can be stored as a cross-tradition structural comparison: coiling=stored potential/recurrence; uncoiling=directed flow; lifting=visibility/transformation.
serpent_spirit_axis.hard_boundary: Do not equate kundalini, biblical serpent, CSF, vagal signaling or Holy Spirit as the same physical substance or historical doctrine.

heart_pineal_thalamus_three_center_model.pineal: threshold/timing/illumination symbol—what opens or marks transition
heart_pineal_thalamus_three_center_model.thalamus: House/integrative interior—what contains differentiated rooms and distributed relations
heart_pineal_thalamus_three_center_model.benefit: Emotion, threshold and containment remain distinct and coupled rather than being forced into one organ.

sistine_chapel_comparator.creation_of_adam: Peer-reviewed medical literature has long debated whether the mantle around God resembles a midsagittal brain. Other interpretations see uterine/birth anatomy or pareidolia. A 2026 review explicitly preserves the ambiguity.
sistine_chapel_comparator.separation_light_darkness: Published neurosurgical interpretation argues for hidden brainstem/spinal/optic anatomy and Neoplatonic symbolism.
sistine_chapel_comparator.last_judgment: Some researchers interpret the central ellipse around Christ as a coronal brain form.
sistine_chapel_comparator.project_value: Use the Sistine Chapel as a history-of-interpretation case where divine creation/light/judgment and brain-shaped sacred enclosures have genuinely been debated—not as proof that Michelangelo encoded Thalamus=Father or Pineal=Son.

ladder_33_relation.spine: physical vertical scaffold and protective canal
ladder_33_relation.33: common vertebral-count convention used symbolically as rod/Ladder; fused elements and counting nuances remain real anatomy rather than numerology
ladder_33_relation.five_spinal_centers: five main spinal chakra groupings in the user's developed model belong to the 33-vertebrae ascent layer; higher Eye/Crown/Spudlight remain above the spinal five
ladder_33_relation.door_sequence: Ladder can be represented as ordered Gates: X_(k+1)=D_k(X_k;Xi_k).

relational_model.heart_brain: Emotion and integrative/perceptual processing are distinct but interacting functions.
relational_model.house_eye: House/Thalamus and Eye/Pineal are neighboring symbols but not identical.
relational_model.spine_house: Spine connects levels; House contains differentiated interior functions.
relational_model.temple_house: Temple frames sacred architecture; House contains rooms/presence.
relational_model.breath_flow: Breath and CSF keep geometry dynamic rather than static.
relational_model.body_world: Body is local Vessel in Plane; Axis relation can change without body disappearing from world.
relational_model.inner_outer: Thalamus/House is especially useful for inner-domain symbolism; Pineal/Son for threshold toward outward presence/manifestation.

research_questions: Recover exact first primary Tim source for Thalamus=Father's House.
Separate historical pineal-third-eye transmission from modern retrospective claims.
Test whether temporal-gating language clarifies Pineal symbolism without importing metaphysical claims into physiology.
Map thalamic paired anatomy and third-ventricle topology only where scientifically useful, without turning resemblance into proof.
Trace serpent/central-channel comparisons with mismatch-first methodology.
Keep Sistine neuroanatomy hypotheses in an explicit disputed/interpretive class.
